company.name: Koala Go
company.shortDescription: The online classroom built for kids.
company.description: Koala Go is a virtual classroom built from the ground up for online tutoring with kids — the use case Zoom and Google Meet weren't designed for. Its signature shared browser feature lets tutors and students share the same web page in real time, so worksheets, games, and reading materials work without screen-share gymnastics or kids juggling tabs. Additional features include AI-generated class notes, class recording, scheduling, and B2B tutoring businesses. Backed by Y Combinator (W22). Built-in whiteboard. Trusted by independent tutors.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,500,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,056,717 to $25,000,000, a 2.76x increase.
